verdict.rationale: Canva has no headless runtime or CI-oriented CLI; the only CLI creates and manages Apps SDK apps. Headless automation is possible through the Connect REST APIs, which ship an OpenAPI description for generating client SDKs and support autofilling Brand Templates, bulk generation, resizing and exports. Private integrations, however, are limited to Enterprise plans. Missing for 10: a CLI or runner for scripted/CI execution of design tasks, documented non-interactive (service-account) authentication for pipelines, CI integration guides or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.
